title: Impossible-travel login (same identity, distant geographies)
message_template: Impossible travel for account {entity}: session geography changed (VPN/identity misuse indicator)
notes: Requires the identity adapter to annotate events with geo fields and session_geo_change (correlates logins for one user within the window). No geolocation DB is bundled; offline GeoLite2 loader is a documented Phase-2 option.
